Social features could be moderated peer circles with trained facilitators, strong reporting tools, age-appropriate defaults, and a rule against sharing numbers, methods, or graphic images. A safety panel should explain data collection, offer deletion controls, and prevent advertisers from targeting health vulnerabilities. Content can include body-neutral nutrition education, coping exercises, and short explanations of how comparison and compulsive tracking can reinforce an eating disorder. Before launch, the team should conduct a clinical safety review, red-team foreseeable misuse, test with specialists, and monitor reports for contagion or coercive behavior.
